extracted.intended_audience: national and subnational government officials, project teams, and development practitioners seeking World Bank Group financing, advisory services, or risk-mitigation products
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the World Bank Group's products, services, and operational standards used to design, finance, implement, and oversee development projects and programs. Includes financing modalities, advisory/analytics roles, and mandatory frameworks for safeguards, procurement, financial management, and results tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suite of financial products and technical advice
rubrics_metrics.description: The World Bank provides a suite of financial products and technical advice and analysis to address development challenges, helping countries find solutions to achieve sustainable and inclusive development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The World Bank, IFC and MIGA can assist clients with: financing public projects and programs, supporting policy reform, providing technical advice and analysis, managing financial risk, attracting and financing private sector investments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financing — public projects and government programs
rubrics_metrics.description: We finance public projects to build physical and social infrastructure, and develop institutional capacity. We also finance government programs to support achievement of their objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financing is used to support policy and institutional reforms of national and subnational governments by providing budget financing and global expertise; applicable to infrastructure, social services, and programmatic reforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advice and Analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Through research and analysis, we offer support to countries in designing or implementing better policies, strengthening institutions, building capacity, informing strategies or operations, and contributing to the global development agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice and analytics are delivered as technical assistance, policy analysis, capacity building, and evidence to inform operations and strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operations Policies / Policies and Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Policies and Procedures apply to all financing and advisory services, and detail roles and responsibilities of The World Bank and our Borrowers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These operational policies set mandatory requirements and procedural steps for projects and programs, defining obligations for both the Bank and borrowing clients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental and Social Framework (ESF)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ESF enables the World Bank and Borrowers to better manage environmental and social risks of projects and to improve development outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects must identify, mitigate, and manage environmental and social risks in line with ESF requirements to protect people and the environment and enhance project sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement Framework for Projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Framework emphasizes choice, quality, and value for public spending, while enabling adaptation to country contexts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procurement should deliver best value (choice/quality/value) and be adaptable to local institutional and market conditions while respecting the Framework's standards and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Management (FM)
rubrics_metrics.description: We support borrowing countries in improving their FM performance and capacity, encouraging transparency, and providing assurance on the use of Bank financing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects and programs are expected to strengthen financial management systems, ensure transparent use of funds, and provide adequate assurance (reporting, audits) on Bank-financed resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Results and Impact Tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: The World Bank tracks progress and results of projects; information is accessible via the Results website, Corporate Scorecard, and IDA Results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should define indicators and monitoring approaches so outcomes can be measured and reported; results tracking is used to assess effectiveness and inform accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: IFC mobilization of private sector investment and advisory services
rubrics_metrics.description: IFC mobilizes private sector investment and provides advice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IFC engagements focus on attracting and financing private investments, providing advisory services to improve private-sector development and investment climate.

rubrics_metrics.name: MIGA political risk insurance (guarantees)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MIGA products mitigate political risks to encourage foreign direct investment and private-sector participation in development projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accountability and Grievance Mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Related accountability mechanisms such as the Inspection Panel, Grievance Redress Service (GRS), and fraud or corruption controls are part of the World Bank Group’s operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects must be subject to these accountability and integrity mechanisms to provide recourse, investigate complaints, and address allegations of fraud, corruption, or policy non-compliance.
